theory Regular

Regular sets

Regular expressions as languages over words, language containment preorder, mutual equivalence, and Kleene algebra.

Constable et al. §11.4

Regular sets, language preorder, and Kleene algebra, following Constable et al. §11.4.

Words are lists over an alphabet `E = Atom`. A language is a predicate `E* → U{i}`. Union `r + s`, concatenation `r s`, and star `r*` are regular expressions. Language containment `Contained(r; s)` forms a preorder (reflexive and transitive), and mutual containment `Req(r; s)` forms an equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive).

17 theorems, 14 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

-- | Regular sets, language preorder, and Kleene algebra, following Constable et al. §11.4.
--
-- Words are lists over an alphabet `E = Atom`. A language is a predicate
-- `E* → U{i}`. Union `r + s`, concatenation `r s`, and star `r*` are
-- regular expressions. Language containment `Contained(r; s)` forms a preorder
-- (reflexive and transitive), and mutual containment `Req(r; s)` forms an
-- equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive).
theory Regular

comment book "Constable et al. §11.4: regular sets, Kleene algebra, and language equivalence."

abs E == Atom
abs Estar == List Atom
abs RE == Estar → U{i}

abs Append(xs; ys) == list_ind xs (ys) (h, t, ih. h :: ih)
abs Flatten(xss) == list_ind xss ([]) (h, t, ih. Append(h; ih))
abs AllIn(r; ys) == list_ind ys True (h, t, v. r h ∧ v)

abs Contained(r; s) == ∀x:Estar. r x → s x
abs Req(r; s) == Contained(r; s) ∧ Contained(s; r)

abs Plus(r; s) == λx. r x ∨ s x
abs Concat(r; s) == λx. ∃u:Estar. ∃v:Estar. Append(u; v) = x ∈ Estar ∧ r u ∧ s v
abs Star(r) ==
  λx. ∃ys:List Estar. AllIn(r; ys) ∧ Flatten(ys) = x ∈ Estar
abs EmptyR == λx. False
abs Epsilon == λx. x = [] ∈ Estar
abs Singleton(a) == λx. x = (a :: []) ∈ Estar

soft E, Estar, RE, Append, Flatten, AllIn, Contained, Req
soft Plus, Concat, Star, EmptyR, Epsilon, Singleton

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Language containment: preorder
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem contained_refl :
  ∀r:RE. Contained(r; r)
proof
  intro r
  intro x
  intro p
  hyp
qed

theorem contained_trans :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. ∀t:RE.
    Contained(r; s) → Contained(s; t) → Contained(r; t)
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro t
  intro rs
  intro st
  intro x
  intro rx
  elim 4 with x THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 8 with rx THENL [
      hyp,
      elim 5 with x THENL [
        hyp,
        elim 10 with y1 THENL [hyp, hyp]
      ]
    ]
  ]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Language equivalence: equivalence relation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem req_refl :
  ∀r:RE. Req(r; r)
proof
  intro r
  split THENL [lemma contained_refl [r] THEN hyp, lemma contained_refl [r] THEN hyp]
qed

theorem req_sym :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. Req(r; s) → Req(s; r)
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro p
  elim 3
  split THENL [hyp 5, hyp 4]
qed

theorem req_trans :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. ∀t:RE. Req(r; s) → Req(s; t) → Req(r; t)
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro t
  intro rs
  intro st
  elim 4
  elim 5
  split THENL [
    lemma contained_trans [r, s, t] THEN elim 10 with u THENL [hyp, elim 11 with u1 THENL [hyp, hyp]],
    lemma contained_trans [t, s, r] THEN elim 10 with v1 THENL [hyp, elim 11 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]]
  ]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Union (Plus) and Empty language
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem plus_left :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. ∀x:Estar. r x → Plus(r; s) x
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro x
  intro p
  left
  hyp
qed

theorem plus_right :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. ∀x:Estar. s x → Plus(r; s) x
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro x
  intro p
  right
  hyp
qed

theorem plus_comm :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. Contained(Plus(r; s); Plus(s; r))
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro x
  intro p
  elim 4 THENL [right THEN hyp, left THEN hyp]
qed

theorem plus_empty_l :
  ∀r:RE. Contained(Plus(r; EmptyR); r)
proof
  intro r
  intro x
  intro p
  elim 3 THENL [hyp, elim 4]
qed

theorem empty_none :
  ∀x:Estar. ¬(EmptyR x)
proof
  intro x
  intro p
  elim 2
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Star and Kleene identities
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The empty word is in every star (`star_lemma_1`).
theorem star_nil :
  ∀r:RE. Star(r) []
proof
  intro r
  exists ([]) THENL [
    auto,
    split THENL [intro, eq]
  ]
qed

-- `r ⊆ r*` (`star_lemma_2`), on a singleton word list.
theorem star_one :
  ∀r:RE. ∀u:Estar. r u → Star(r) u
proof
  intro r
  intro u
  intro p
  exists (u :: []) THENL [
    auto,
    split THENL [
      reduce THEN split THENL [hyp, intro],
      auto
    ]
  ]
qed

theorem plus_star_nil :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. Star(Plus(r; s)) []
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  lemma star_nil [Plus(r; s)] THEN hyp
qed

-- `r ⊆ r+s`, hence a word of `r` is in `(r+s)*`.
theorem r_in_plus_star :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. ∀u:Estar. r u → Star(Plus(r; s)) u
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  intro u
  intro p
  lemma star_one [Plus(r; s), u] THEN elim 5 THEN left THEN hyp
qed

theorem kleene_epsilon :
  ∀r:RE. ∀s:RE. Star(Plus(r; s)) [] ∧ Star(r) [] ∧ Star(s) []
proof
  intro r
  intro s
  split THENL [
    lemma star_nil [Plus(r; s)] THEN hyp,
    split THENL [
      lemma star_nil [r] THEN hyp,
      lemma star_nil [s] THEN hyp
    ]
  ]
qed

theorem epsilon_nil :
  Epsilon []
proof
  eq
qed

theorem singleton_a :
  Singleton("a") ("a" :: [])
proof
  eq THEN auto
qed
